name: Autocomplete List
description: an entity-reference field widget offering a single autocomplete box plus a list of selected references.
project_description:
This module provides a widget for a multi-valued entity reference field.

It is represented as an autocomplete field with values organized as a list with ability to delete each item.

 Known Issues 
 #3100519: Incompatibility with Paragraphs (Entity Reference Revisions) fields 

 When the Autocomplete List widget is used with Paragraphs or other entity reference revisions fields, selected items may not be displayed or saved correctly.

The issue is under investigation, and a fix is being developed.
